_noteRefresh1616: 16.16 BIN REFRESH (loop 495). Q HealthDamagePercent stopped being a flat 9 and became per rank, 6.5/7/7.5/8/8.5 (the DataValue reads [6.5,7,7.5,8,8.5,9,9.5] and the curation indexes it by rank). A max-rank Q is unchanged at 9 percent, which is why this drift was invisible to any spot-check at rank 5 - what was wrong was every rank BELOW it, where the app was claiming 9 percent for an ability that deals as little as 6.5. Q flat damage also moved, 430 to 355 at the probe stats. MaxHealthDamageToNonHeroes rose too but is out of scope for a champion-target calculator. W PassiveResistPercent 12 to 16 is a resistance, not damage.
_noteEWall: E WALL SLAM (loop 483, user request). Default unmet, so the floor is the charge alone and ticking the box adds the slam - the same shape Briar E and K'Sante R use.
